Torkoal is pure Fire, so my Flare Blitz is resisted. Its Fire moves are also resisted by my Dark/Fire Incineroar. Plan: Parting Shot to cut Torkoal's Atk and SpA and bring in Garchomp, which outspeeds Torkoal (Spe 36-79) and hits it super effectively with Earthquake. Garchomp can Mega-evolve and Swords Dance later. Gholdengo is the backup. Opponent still has Rotom, Scrafty, Sinistchamasterpiece or Simisear to come. Keep Incineroar's Sitrus Berry and Intimidate in reserve. Avoid Earthquake into Rotom (Levitate).
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Torkoal's Flare Blitz won't do much against its own Fire typing's resistances, and since it's likely running Drought to boost its Fire moves, I'm weighing whether to switch to Garchomp, which takes neutral damage from Fire as a Dragon/Ground type.

Incineroar is actually a decent answer since Fire/Dark resists Fire attacks, making Torkoal's Flare Blitz weak against it. But rather than trading hits, using Parting Shot to drop Torkoal's offenses before pivoting into Garchomp seems stronger — Garchomp outspeeds the slow Torkoal and its Earthquake hits for massive super-effective damage, setting up a clean Mega Evolution next turn.
